Summary: Energy consumption per successful agent task varies greatly, from fractions of a watt-hour to hundreds of watt-hours, depending on the complexity and scale of the AI system. Advanced AI agents can consume significantly more energy than simpler models. Efficiency improvements are ongoing to reduce this energy use.
